description:
## Approved scope
Admin-owned global Web browsing settings; domain list empty means unrestricted. Reuse Skills datasource folder picker but maintain independent screenshot settings. Remove agent-owned domain overrides; improve descriptions. Preserve existing browser session selection. Automatic screenshot capture -> existing create_document Action upload -> compact document metadata, with one temporary file and guaranteed cleanup. Final filename includes final-URL page slug, UTC timestamp and collision-resistant random ID under final-hostname subfolder.

## Delivery and non-goals
Planning only in this pass: no application changes or branch creation. Future implementation: new branch in current worktree (suggested feat/web-browsing-config-screenshots), not a second worktree; no commit/push without separate authorization. Leave conversation/actor session binding and reset to https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/825. No general artifact/materialization expansion, model base64 handoff, new browser SDK, visual reasoning or hot daemon manager. Domain policy edits require restarting all Agent containers for guaranteed effect; destination edits apply to subsequent captures. Deployment migration must deliberately preserve any existing env restriction in the new setting.

## Source audit and reuse evidence
Browsing lives in lib/zaq/agent/tools/web/browsing.ex. SkillsTab reuses DesignSystem.DataSourceFolderPicker with DataSourceBrowser; System owns grouped settings exposed through Engine events. CreateDocument already supports base64 and kind: folder, but scope_id must be checked/preserved for selected datasource scope. Channels data_source_create_file owns provider execution and TrustedContext. Pinned agent-browser ce1f1f5f8123b97f16aa08e9375659fcdf9c47ab screenshot returns path, not image data even in JSON; one file is unavoidable without expanding scope. Browser startup-only allowlist behavior is operationally documented, not modeled in a new runtime manager. Related issues zaq-0oy (Skills scope), zaq-dqu (shared browser helpers), zaq-5j6/zaq-5j6.2 (actual browser integration) are reuse/overlap references, not unverified blockers.

## Execution order
Sequential implementation is intentional for the requested single current-worktree workflow and shared config/browser files. It is not a claim that all code domains are inherently coupled. No diamonds or cycles.
1. zaq-xfj.1 — Add typed global Web browsing configuration
2. zaq-xfj.2 — Add Web browsing tab with reused datasource destination picker
3. zaq-xfj.3 — Make browser policy admin-owned and clarify tool descriptions
4. zaq-xfj.4 — Preserve datasource scope in reusable create_document action
5. zaq-xfj.5 — Capture page screenshots and persist to configured datasource
6. zaq-xfj.6 — Obtain human approval of Web browsing settings and screenshot workflow
7. zaq-xfj.7 — Finalize Web browsing UI and Docker screenshot end-to-end coverage
8. zaq-xfj.8 — Complete documentation consistency and final validation handoff

```mermaid
graph LR
  zaq_xfj.1 --> zaq_xfj.2 --> zaq_xfj.3 --> zaq_xfj.4 --> zaq_xfj.5 --> zaq_xfj.6 --> zaq_xfj.7 --> zaq_xfj.8
```

## Quality and approval
All implementation children specify tests-first, error paths, dependency seams, ownership and Action reuse. Human UX approval blocks consolidated E2E authoring. Earlier plan approval is not UX approval of implementation. After E2E, complete documentation/coverage/final gates per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Parent epic is tracking-only and must not be used as an E2E prerequisite; do not close it until all required validation and approvals have actual evidence.
title: [zaq-xfj] Web browsing global policy and automatic screenshot storage
